title: Grays as biological drones

tellings.quote: these grays cuz that's what he said. They were these grays um seem to be these biological drones.

plain: The Grays, the small grey-skinned beings described in many UFO stories, are said to be biological drones rather than independent creatures. The YouTube creator Chris Ramsay tells Michels this is what an anonymous poster claiming to be a whistleblower said in a thread on 4chan, an anonymous online message board.
